title: PA Periods — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: An appraisal period for the older PA Form — for example "FY 2026". Each employee can have one PA Form per period. The performance appraisal and PA summary reports can be filtered by it.

fields.label: Name
fields.html:
What it is. The period's name. It must be unique.

Example. FY 2026

fields.label: Closed
fields.html:
What it is. Whether the period is closed.

Why it matters. Not read at present.
